practices.rule: Confirm who needs the output, remove redundant work, and redesign unclear processes before automating.
Deduct upkeep, include rollout and training effort, and withhold overlapping baselines before ranking savings.
Keep forecasts separate from dated observations. Preserve zero results and never add repeated observations together.
Keep stable process identities, reject stale edits, preserve operator inputs, and make interrupted saves safe to retry.
Enter credentials only in Connections. Bind them to the current Google user and workbook; keep them out of sheets and logs.
Hold unconfirmed Slack, paid-model, and Asana writes for review or reconciliation instead of blindly repeating them.
Treat AI classifications as suggestions. Review uncertainty against labeled examples before relying on model output.
Install independent workbooks with only the scopes declared for their suite and approve live actions explicitly.
